title: All installation documentation should recommend checking for patches
description: {panel:bgColor=#e7f4fa}   *NOTE:* This suggestion is for *JIRA Server*. Using *JIRA Cloud*? [See the corresponding suggestion|http://jira.atlassian.com/browse/JRACLOUD-34196].   {panel}  When a customer goes to install any Atlassian product they are carefully lead through what they will need, except for checking for patches for the version they are installing. It would be helpful for all installation documents to have a sentence such as """"If you are installing a version earlier than the latest released version, please check for security updates at XYZ""""    If a customer doesn't do this, they might install an older version that should be patched for security reasons, but they won't know that.
